title: Agent profile (one persona's behaviour distribution)
description: Everything the agent runner needs for one persona: house, simulation period, and behaviours. A behaviour is either a hidden pattern (kind 'pattern', the ground truth to be learned) or ordinary life (kind 'routine'). Both use the structured-pattern parts of pattern.schema.json (trigger, conditions, actions). Conventions inside actions: any args value may be {"choice": [..], "weights": [..]} (one option drawn each time, weights optional) and a number may be {"min": a, "max": b} (uniform). A time range whose 'to' is earlier than 'from' runs past midnight and belongs to the day it starts.

seed.description: random seed: the same profile and seed give the same year

start.description: Where the person is at the first minute.

pattern.description: kind 'pattern' only: the full structured pattern (pattern.schema.json) it comes from, kept for reference and ground truth

probability.description: chance the behaviour happens when the trigger fires and the conditions hold (a pattern's followProbability)

priority.description: when two behaviours want the person at the same minute, the higher one goes first (default 0)

cookingMinutes.description: This person's usual cooking time: every time the stove is turned on, a time is drawn and the person turns it off then (a step may override it). Default lognormal, median 15, sigma 0.6.
